name: MsoBarPosition
description: Specifies the position or behavior of a command bar.

constants.name: msoBarLeft
constants.description: Command bar is docked on the left side of the application window.

constants.name: msoBarTop
constants.description: Command bar is docked at the top of the application window.

constants.name: msoBarRight
constants.description: Command bar is docked on the right side of the application window.

constants.name: msoBarBottom
constants.description: Command bar is docked at the bottom of the application window.

constants.name: msoBarFloating
constants.description: Command bar floats on top of the application window.

constants.name: msoBarPopup
constants.description: Command bar will be a shortcut menu.

constants.name: msoBarMenuBar
constants.description: Command bar will be a menu bar (Macintosh only).
